seo.title: Hakomi Sessions Online & on Kauaʻi | Tender of the Soul
seo.description: Learn what to expect from online and in-person Hakomi sessions with Tender of the Soul.

hero.title: A place to slow down and listen.
hero.introduction: Collaborative, gently paced Hakomi sessions for adults, online or in person from a private home office on Kauaʻi.

details.heading: 60–90 minutes
details.body: Enough time to arrive, follow what is present, and close with care.

details.heading: Online
details.body: Meet from a private, comfortable place anywhere the service can appropriately be offered.

details.heading: In person
details.body: A quiet, private home office on Kauaʻi. Access details are shared before your visit.

expect.heading: Your experience leads.
expect.paragraphOne: A session begins by contacting what feels alive in the present moment. Rather than imposing a predetermined agenda, Elana follows your unfolding process with you.
expect.paragraphTwo: You might notice sensation, emotion, an image, a memory, a shift in breathing, a gesture, or words that seem to carry particular weight. There is no correct way to experience a session.

steps.heading: Arrive
steps.body: We begin with what is here today.

steps.heading: Notice
steps.body: Attention gently turns toward present-moment experience.

steps.heading: Follow
steps.body: We stay curious about what unfolds, without forcing.

steps.heading: Integrate
steps.body: We make space to orient and close with steadiness.

choice.quote: Nothing needs to be pushed open. You remain an active participant in every part of the process.
choice.heading: You can pause at any time.
choice.paragraphOne: We work collaboratively. You can ask questions, change direction, slow down, or stop. Protective responses are approached with respect, not treated as resistance.
choice.paragraphTwo: No previous experience with mindfulness, somatic work, or therapy is needed.

firstSession.heading: An invitation to experience yourself differently.
firstSession.statement: The first session offers a compassionate place to slow down, connect with what is alive inside, and begin noticing what may be asking to move, soften, or be met.
firstSession.body: There is no expectation of a dramatic breakthrough. We will also make room for questions, context, and a conversation about what support might feel useful.
